'''Richard Harmon Force Drain, Capture, and Power''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Richard Harmon]]
* '''Published:''' July 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Star Destroyer: Launch Bay]]
* '''Strategy:''' Force Drain, Capture, and Power
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDag Force Drain, Capture, and Power Har.txt |Download]]
